F.construction: Inflated component circumdisks give measured angular half-widths asin((rho+gap/2)/r). Deterministic pairwise cyclic-order projection, 128 sweeps, only precomputed visual C0 movable. Largest original empty arc is seam; canonical index breaks ties. Angles use their own independently projected label band; their true anchors do not move. No 16/40-degree spacing, no post-actual tuning.
F.native_target: Q44 centered at each point/marker display origin, union with visible component rectangles; one existing glyph-control per key

E.native_target: Same one glyph-control, same role/key/tab stop/action; Q44 center shifted 12 CSS px radially outward, plus component rectangles so the visible glyph remains activatable. No added visible/off-glyph control, no proxy button, no extra action. The full union and paint order must be verified.
E.semantic_stop: If implementation would add a separate off-glyph control, lose glyph activation, add an action/tab stop or change canonical behavior, stop E-browser only; keep independent F/analytics. A failed hit test rejects this geometry, not authority to change semantics.

difference_from_D004: New experimental radii and independently movable angle labels. Point/marker default origin remains on declared reference circle. Allowed display domain is declared annulus/clip with preserved cyclic order. Candidate endpoints are angular-projected; return path is explicit straight chord q(u)=P+u(A-P), NOT D004 fixed-radius arc. Euclidean CSS chord displacement and min(1,d) replace arc length only for this named hypothesis; no normative criterion is silently changed. Full chord prefix must satisfy all predicates. Adoption still requires reviewer/Manager decision.
C0: Compute once on default union of ink/stroke/contour/focus component AABBs, across points, signed conjunctions and angle labels. Hit overlap alone never changes C0. Freeze all other labels. Fixed rings/zodiac/cusps/true anchors/aspect endpoints/DTO/HTML are immutable. Decorations are not label obstacles.
bounds: Reuse published ink metrics for conditional analytic input. Include glyph selected stroke 0.75 and focus rectangle at envelope+3; category text is a separate component, contour only symbol. Angle labels are components and can move only if original C0. Full closed rectangles contained in declared annuli and [0,S]^2 clip, Euclidean union gap>=2. No shrinking after clip.
hit: T_i is union of Q rectangle and component hit rectangles; H_i removes viewport/overflow clipping and later-painted targets. Q is half-open 44x44, not constrained to visual annulus. Static rectangle certificate checks complete Q, native coordinate probes check actual topmost owner/composed path/activation separately; element.click() is not evidence.
precision: Published binary64 coordinates are decimal input to independent Fraction predicates. Static gap/annulus/clip comparisons exact for those rectangles; trigonometric anchor reference is independent and approximate within 0.5px, no added acceptance epsilon. 1px step parameter is enclosed using exact integer sqrt bounds; positive return witness uses a rational parameter and full piecewise-quadratic path check. Equality ambiguity is UNPROVEN, not expanded tolerance.
